    # For n=4, p=[2,1,4,3] works (divisors: 1,2,4)
    # General pattern: swap adjacent pairs to minimize divisors
    p = [0] * (n + 1)
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        if j % 2 == 1:
            p[j] = j + 1 if j + 1 <= n else j - 1
        else:
            p[j] = j - 1 if j - 1 >= 1 else j + 1
    # Fix the last element if n is even
    if n % 2 == 0:
        p[n] = n - 1
        p[n-1] = n
    else:
        p[n] = n - 1

    if n % 2 == 1:
        p[n] = n
        p[n-1] = n-1

    for j in range(1, n + 1, 2):
